Bienvenido a las Nacionales Argentinas 2023.
Este torneo cuenta con todas las categorías oficiales de la WCA y otorgará el honor de "Campeón Nacional" a los ganadores de cada categoría.
**POR FAVOR LEER LAS PESTAÑAS ["IMPORTANTE"](#31830-importante-important) Y ["PAGO"](#31831-pago-payment) PARA REALIZAR EL REGISTRO CORRECTAMENTE.**

---
Welcome to the Nacionales Argentinas 2023.
This tournament features all the official events of the WCA and will award the honor of "National Champion" to the winners of each category.
**PLEASE READ THE ["IMPORTANT"](#31830-importante-important) AND ["PAYMENT"](#31831-pago-payment) TABS IN ORDER TO REGISTER SUCCESSFULLY.**

items.name: Oregon Championship 2023
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OregonChampionship2023#30885-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
